name: ohmyink-stencil-processing

sourcePolicy.selection: Search validated catalog records first using category/art style filters and strict meaningful theme facets; ignore colorMix for retrieval.
sourcePolicy.catalogHit: Return up to four catalog records only. Do not add AI padding or unrelated catalog records.
sourcePolicy.aiFallback: Only a valid free-text request with zero applicable catalog records persists an AI source decision and queues one 2x2 contact-sheet generation.
sourcePolicy.exactCatalogId: An explicit catalog ID must resolve to a valid allowed record. Invalid or filter-mismatched IDs fail without AI fallback.
sourcePolicy.legacyQueued: Old unversioned queued rows remain catalog-only and never gain a secret AI fallback.
sourcePolicy.idempotency: A verified clientId/requestId/capabilityToken returns the persisted job before source selection or provider work.

instantDrawProfile.conceptPolicy: Reject mandala or mandalas and the Chinese forms 曼陀羅, 曼陀罗, 曼荼羅, and 曼荼罗.
instantDrawProfile.artDirection: One small recognizable motif with approximately 6–12 clean strokes as guidance, minimal interior detail, open whitespace, and no dense effects. AI fallback originals are simple black outlines even for Cyber & ornamental.

queue.idempotency: clientId + requestId; client pre-persists a secure 256-bit capabilityToken for response-loss recovery

pipeline: validate input against the instant-draw profile, including noMandala; the frontend submits its blank-state Surprise me value as a normal catalog-first request
apply source category and art-style choices before strict catalog matching; colorMix is persisted only as output intent

persist a V3 catalog decision (catalog IDs, filters, colorMode, fillEnclosedRegions) or V1 AI decision (concept, mapped art style, blackwork base, filters, colorMode, fillEnclosedRegions) before enqueueing

for catalog decisions, read selected original PNG files from assets/catalog/inspiration and store exact bytes; for AI decisions, call ImageService once for a 2x2 outline contact sheet and persist four separately split originals

for V2 color rows use ink-only compatibility; for V3 and AI color rows use the referenced full-design color helper with fillEnclosedRegions true; monochrome remains deterministic and original mode does not edit
derive mirrored artist PNG/SVG only from each uncolored normal-orientation original

recovery.startup: before accepting HTTP requests, mark all prior generating/processing jobs failed and re-enqueue queued jobs
recovery.interruptedPost: resubmit the same clientId/requestId and pre-saved capabilityToken; verified ownership returns the existing persisted source decision without another provider run
recovery.catalogProcessingFailure: guest explicitly creates a new request; no automatic retry
recovery.aiFallbackFailure: mark the AI job failed with a safe English message; never fall back to catalog after an ImageService failure and never automatically retry paid work
recovery.colorVersionFailure: mark the job failed with a safe color-specific English message; no automatic paid retry or unchanged-image fallback

limitation: This API-process queue is not a distributed durable worker system. Use one worker instance; completed artwork and metadata are durable. This JSON describes the workflow; actual tunable image-processing values come from runtimeOverrides environment variables.
